The two small black circles below the main woofer on the left speaker lack clear depth or functional definition. They appear slightly fused into the white casing without distinct bezels or shadows, making their physical structure ambiguous compared to the main driver.

The perspective lines of the right speaker's box are slightly inconsistent with the left speaker, and the elliptical shape of the driver suggests a slight warping rather than a perfect geometric projection.
